title: Incremental output telemetry: deterministic chunk IDs, trace linking, and adaptive redaction
creator: Ava Martinez
description: We need to instrument incremental/streamed responses with stable per-chunk telemetry IDs that can be correlated to tracing spans and logs while applying configurable PII redaction. This work covers schema changes to telemetry payloads, deterministic chunk-id generation across retries and resumptions, deterministic mapping to OpenTelemetry spans, redaction hooks that operate in the streaming path, compatibility shims for v1/v2 API clients, and storage/transmission constraints (size, encryption). The objective is to provide actionable per-chunk metrics (latency, token_count, model_variant, chunk_order) and traceable links to full request context without exposing raw streamed content in logs or telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Each streamed chunk emitted by the runtime contains a deterministic 'chunk_id' stable across retries and resumptions
Chunk-level telemetry events include: chunk_id, request_id, model_variant, token_count, token_latency_ms, chunk_order, semantic_tag list (e.g., prompt, function_call, tool_output)
Every chunk can be correlated 1:1 to an OpenTelemetry span with a stable span-id that is linked in observability UIs
PII redaction pipeline applied to any telemetry/log payloads containing user-provided strings; redaction rules configurable per-customer and documented
Backward compatibility: v1 clients continue to receive streaming payloads unchanged; v2 clients can opt-in to enriched telemetry via header 'X-RI-Telemetry: enriched=1'
End-to-end tests exercising retry/resume scenarios confirm chunk_id stability and correct span recreation
Performance regression under representative load < 5% p99 latency increase
implementation_notes: Generate chunk_id as sha256(request_id + '|' + sequence_number + '|' + model_version + '|' + resume_counter) and base64-url encode to 16 bytes for parity with existing metadata fields
Attach chunk span as child of the request-level span. Use span attributes: chunk_id, token_count, chunk_order, model_variant
Telemetry event batcher should strip/transform any fields marked as 'sensitive' before emit; integrate with existing redaction service (redactd)
Add compatibility shim in API gateway that strips enriched telemetry for clients without opt-in header
Add sampling policy: full telemetry for P0/P1 customers; 1% sampling for free-tier tokens; head-based sampling for long-lived streams
Use protobuf schema change with optional fields to avoid breaking older consumers; version as ri.streaming.v2.ChunkTelemetry
test_plan: Unit tests for chunk_id generation covering resume and retry edge cases
Integration tests with OpenTelemetry collector to assert span linkage and attributes
Load tests with 5000 concurrent streaming sessions to measure p95/p99 impact
Fuzz tests to confirm redaction pipeline removes all matching PII regex patterns
E2E QA with a greenfield v2 client to verify opt-in flow and disabled-by-default behavior for v1
rollout_plan: Feature-flag gated rollout: deploy v1 API gateway shim and runtime changes off by default
Stage 1 (internal): enable for internal teams and infra customers for 48h smoke
Stage 2 (beta): enable opt-in for 10 pilot customers; monitor telemetry and errors for 7 days
Stage 3 (canary): enable for 5% of traffic across diverse regions; validate latency and privacy metrics
Stage 4 (gradual): increase to 100% with a one-week monitoring window and automated rollback on SLO breach
